interactions.advice: Warfarin with capecitabine can raise bleeding risk. Talk to your pharmacist.
Capecitabine can raise phenytoin levels in your blood. Talk to your doctor.
Rifampicin (a TB medicine) can make imatinib work less well. Tell your doctor before starting it.
Grapefruit and grapefruit juice can raise imatinib levels. Avoid them.
Fluoxetine can make tamoxifen work less well. Talk to your doctor.
Paroxetine can make tamoxifen work less well. Talk to your doctor.
St John's wort can make imatinib work less well. Do not take it with imatinib.
Clarithromycin can raise imatinib levels and side effects. Talk to your doctor.
Carbamazepine can make imatinib work less well. Talk to your doctor.
Phenytoin can make imatinib work less well. Talk to your doctor.
Tamoxifen with warfarin can raise bleeding risk. Talk to your doctor.
Regular paracetamol with imatinib can strain the liver. Ask your pharmacist how much is safe.
